The *Siṅgālamātutherīapadāna* is a verse narrative preserved in the Therīapadāna section of the Pali canonical Khuddaka Nikāya (designated Thi Ap 34) [SuttaCentral]. The text recounts the biographical verses and past aspirations associated with the elder nun (therī) Siṅgālamātā [SuttaCentral]. While no curated cross-tradition parallels are listed on SuttaCentral, translations of the text into five languages are indexed [SuttaCentral].

Its most significant overlap occurs with the commentary to the *Therīgāthā* (*Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā*), comprising 95 matches (e.g., segment range §11.1–15.3), as well as both volumes of the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus].
